subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 10: Over to you! and Review
outcomes: I can read comments about technology and give my opinion.
I can use could/couldn’t, had to/didn’t have to and comparative adverbs.
I can remember and use the technology words from Unit 2.

tf.s: Nadia’s app tells her if she says a word right.
tf.why: Yes, she clicks pictures, hears and says words, and the app checks her.

tf.s: Najla downloaded a book onto her e-reader because she reads really slowly.
tf.why: Now she can listen to the book too.

tf.s: Katya changed the first verse of the poem.
tf.why: She changed the last verse, about making videos.

tf.s: The part of a tablet that you look at is the screen.
tf.why: You look at the screen to see pictures and words.

tf.s: “We didn’t had to wear uniform.” is correct.
tf.why: After didn’t we use the base form: didn’t have to.

tf.s: The comparative adverb of clearly is more clearly.
tf.why: Long adverbs use more: more clearly.

tf.s: The comparative adverb of fast is more fast.
tf.why: We say faster, not more fast.

tf.s: “They couldn’t use the computers yesterday.” talks about the past.
tf.why: Couldn’t is the past of can’t.

tf.s: “He doesn’t have to go to school today” means he must go to school.
tf.why: Doesn’t have to means it is not necessary.

tf.s: “I liked the poem because it was fun to perform.” gives an opinion and a reason.
tf.why: I liked … because … gives an opinion with a reason.

boxes.q: Complete: I read ___ than my sister. (fast)
Complete: She speaks English ___ than me. (clearly)
Correct the sentence: “We didn’t had to wear uniform.”
o: We didn’t have to wear uniform.
We didn’t has to wear uniform.
We don’t had to wear uniform.

boxes.q: What did Katya change in the poem?
boxes.why: She changed the last verse, about making videos.

boxes.q: Why did Najla use an e-reader?
boxes.why: She can listen to the book as well as read it.

boxes.q: Complete: My grandfather ___ walk to school.
boxes.why: had to tells us it was necessary in the past.

boxes.q: Complete: Yesterday I ___ open the app. It didn’t work.
boxes.why: Yesterday is the past, so we use couldn’t.

o: I liked the lesson because it was fun.
boxes.why: I liked … because … gives your opinion.

boxes.q: Complete: You can find your way ___ on the phone.
boxes.why: We use the adverb easily after the verb.

boxes.q: How does Nadia learn English with her app?
o: She clicks pictures and hears and says words.
She watches films at the cinema.
boxes.why: The app also tells her if she is right.

hunt.q: Part of a tablet you look at

mcq.q: What was the last verse of Katya’s poem about?
mcq.why: Katya wrote a new last verse about making videos.

mcq.q: Which sentence is from the dictation?
o: They couldn’t use the computers yesterday.
mcq.why: This is one of the three dictation sentences.

mcq.q: Which phrase do we use to give an opinion?
mcq.why: I liked … because … gives an opinion and a reason.

mcq.q: Which group of words is all devices?
mcq.why: Tablets, laptops and smartphones are devices.

o: I write better than my brother.
I write gooder than my brother.
I write more good than my brother.
I write weller than my brother.
mcq.why: The comparative of well is better.

mcq.q: Today is a holiday. Which sentence is correct?
o: He doesn’t have to go to school today.
He has to go to school today.
He couldn’t go to school today.
He had to go to school today.
mcq.why: On a holiday it is not necessary to go to school.

mcq.q: In the past, there were no computers at school. Which sentence fits?
o: Students don’t have to use computers today.
mcq.why: Couldn’t talks about something that was not possible in the past.

mcq.q: Which is a good point about technology, not a bad one?
o: We can learn quickly with apps.
We spend too much time on screens.
mcq.why: Learning quickly is a benefit of technology.

o: She can listen to a book because she reads slowly.
She can play games all day.
She doesn’t have to read anymore.
She can take photos of books.
mcq.why: Listening helps her enjoy books even though she reads slowly.

mcq.q: Which comment is about technology and learning?
o: My app helps me learn new English words.
I went to the park with my family.
mcq.why: It shows how an app helps someone learn.
